deliverable: A reversible stock BO3 engine patch, a shareable Windows patch-loader executable, and a reviewed real pull request.
reportedSymptoms: Long AAE Zombies matches can show Connection Interrupted.
BO3 remains open while the match or hosting session stops responding; an internal server crash is not yet confirmed.
Repeated Pack-a-Punched War Machine fire is a reported trigger.
The failure may occur in solo and co-op, but occurs more often in co-op.

firstCapture.hostRole: Record the actual role. Host on the capture PC for a co-op server capture.

hypotheses: Projectiles, power-ups, or other server entities exhaust a resource.
Temporary effects or network events exceed a limit during a volley.
Projectile cleanup or script tasks accumulate over repeated volleys.
An unrelated script error or network failure ends the match.

limits: Connection Interrupted alone does not identify the exhausted resource.
OS threads are not GSC script threads.
Window response is not internal server health.
A failure snapshot needs the manual marker while the process is alive.
A process exit is recorded automatically, but a full exit-time dump is not guaranteed.
No debugger, DLL injection, engine patch, or game configuration change is part of this first capture.

labStatus.quietSdkInterception: Eight groups across fourteen memory child traces and fresh review passed. Seventy-four sources, four binaries, three missing-companion refusals, exact SDK exports and initialization inventory were bound. One physical-silent worker run stopped with E_PENDING at DSOUND's internal MMDeviceEnumerator request, outer Sound and depth one, before any DirectSound Play. Two WASAPI first packets and Starts succeeded. Parent endpoint controls/defaults matched; binaries were unchanged and no owned process remained. Forced termination does not verify callback release or graceful cleanup. rawPublications detects memory objects only. Address this exact original-provider nesting before claiming physical integration.
labStatus.quietContainedProvider: The new narrow source rule has eleven passing memory groups across twenty-five native child traces, three missing-companion refusals and fresh review. Seventy-eight sources, four unchanged binaries and nineteen helper COFF objects are bound. Authority is thread-local around only physical saved OriginalSound. Admission requires the audited class, IID, context, null aggregation, exact caller identity and new live setup bytes. Ordinary output storage is unread; only a fully qualified audited call checks its initially-null slot. Memory cases cannot admit original-provider authority. Genuine Windows admission, active contained recursion and repeated positive calls remain source-only. Physical execution stays held during Peyton's manual session.
labStatus.sdkOriginalProviderRole: The bounded current-disk DSOUND audit proves null aggregation, CLSCTX_ALL, and exact MMDeviceEnumerator/IMMDeviceEnumerator arguments. The local function enumerates active render endpoints and all default roles, reads IDs/names, and releases its interfaces without client activation. Public adapters cannot serve that internal role. The historical trace lacks mapped-byte hashes. A contained exception must verify new live setup bytes, exact caller identity, thread and actual saved OriginalSound scope, while rejecting active COM recursion and unrelated nesting. Do not infer a one-call constructor limit or block unrelated wrapped requests solely because another thread has an active scope.
